description: Found by the specled_-dn4 merge gate 2026-07-25. property Tracer.merge_edges/3 (specled.compiler_tracer.merge_on_flush) at test/specled_ex/compiler/tracer_test.exs:241-255 fails deterministically under seed 407930 with StreamData.TooManyDuplicatesError: uniq_list_of draws from a tiny module-atom space (ModA..ModD observed) and 10 consecutive duplicates abort generation. Reproduced identically at main (14f6e72) with the same seed — pre-existing, NOT caused by the dn4 epic; passes under typical seeds (4 independent full-suite green runs same day). Fix: widen the generator space or bound uniqueness (e.g. uniq_list_of(member_of(mods), max_length: length(mods)) or drop uniq constraint). Any seed can strike CI.
title: Seed-deterministic property failure: tracer_test.exs:241 merge_edges uniq_list_of over ~4-atom space (TooManyDuplicatesError, seed 407930)
